data.title: Opal Gardens
data.about:
In Dubai’s most exclusive address, District 11 Opal Gardens offers spectacular residences in the newest high-end development. 

Opal Gardens provides exquisite residences with attention to every detail. The homes in District 11 Opal Gardens are meticulously designed for your comfort and feature breathtaking views of the Dubai cityscape and crystal lagoon. Choose from a collection of exquisite 4, 5 to 6 Bedroom Villas, Semi-detached Villas, and Townhouses.

location_tile.title: One of Meydan’s most popular and well-established neighbourhoods.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description: Meydan’s District 11 is one of the most popular and established neighborhoods in Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City. A gorgeous crystal lagoon and beautiful green spaces surround District 11 Opal Gardens, which offers easy access to Downtown Dubai.
